scope: Pre-AC1024 DXF DIMSTYLE DIMTXTDIRECTION group-295 output

evidence.format_crosswalk: The project DIMSTYLE descriptor maps group 295 to DIMTXTDIRECTION with minimum revision AC1024; ODA DWG v5.4.1 lists the field as R2010+. Autodesk documents DIMTXTDIRECTION as a system variable introduced for current supported releases, with initial value 0. The parser stores group 295 in the typed field and syncStructToVars maps that field back to group 295.

references.title: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files

evidence.code: dxfRW::writeDimstyle now refuses pre-AC1024 output when the typed dimtxtdirection field or a dynamic group-295 override is nonzero. The default left-to-right value remains omitted.
evidence.control: libdxfrw_dimstyle_table_allocation generates typed and dynamic nonzero cases and verifies atomic refusal plus same-writer retry after restoring zero in ASCII and Binary AC1021; clean ASCII output is checked for absence of DIMSTYLE group 295.
evidence.fixture_policy: Generated controls write only to the system temporary directory; no DWG or DXF fixture added to the repository.
limits: This is a version-loss refusal guard, not a native dimension-rendering qualification.
Accepted compatibility spellings 292 and 294 are parse-only; this slice does not establish a legacy output mapping for them.
